# Blindly

> Blindly is a blind dating app in India. There are no profile photos or bios. You choose your mood, talk with people who feel the same by voice and chat, and both of you stay anonymous until you mutually agree to reveal your identities.

## Key facts
- Category: blind dating app (mobile, iOS and Android)
- Market: India
- How it works: choose a mood (for example Coffee or Dinner, A Long Drive, Netflix and Chill), record a 30-second video clip intro (with the option to add voice notes along with it), talk anonymously, reveal only by mutual consent
- Safety: liveness verification, identities hidden until mutual reveal, screen-recording detection and forensic tracing of leaked videos (in beta), in-app reporting
- Price: free; passes can be earned by inviting friends
- Age: 18+ only
- Company: Ayrav Technologies Private Limited
- Phone: +91 7795684854
- Address: 53118, Sobha Dream Acres, Panathur Main Road, Balagere, Muthusandra, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560087, India
- Contact: info@blindly.date · Safety: safety@blindly.date · Careers: career@blindly.date · Press: press@blindly.date · Grievance: grievance@blindly.date
